programme.title: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Technology
programme.teaching_language: Chinese (HSK required); the college says over 90% of principal courses are taught bilingually or in English
programme.how_found: College of Computer Science and Technology English site; International College 2026 catalogue.
programme.notes: All international-admission figures are from the 2026 cycle (Application Guide for Undergraduate Programs 2026 and its catalogues); the 2027 guide was not yet published on iczu.zju.edu.cn on 2026-10-19.

english.quote: must provide proof of English proficiency, such as TOEFL (80 or higher), IELTS (6.5 or higher).
english.notes: 2026 catalogue (Chinese-taught). The College of Computer Science and Technology row group shares one merged cell: 'Score 180 in HSK Level 5' plus 'Applicants whose native language is not English, or who have not completed a high school diploma in the English language, must provide proof of English proficiency, such as TOEFL (80 or higher), IELTS (6.5 or higher).' The PDF prints the cell on the Industrial Design line; that it spans Computer Science and Technology is read from the merged layout. Chinese (HSK 5, 180) is the primary language requirement.

gpa.notes: No grade threshold published: 'Students are admitted on the basis of competitive selection according to their academic performance in senior high school, language proficiency and performance in the interview' (prose); a CSCA report is required from 2026/27 (test, no published minimum).

deadline.quote: programs without a specially noted application deadline, the application deadline is February 28, 2026, Beijing time.
deadline.notes: 2026 cycle only (application 1 December 2025 - 28 February 2026, Application Guide for Undergraduate Programs 2026). The 2027 guide is not published yet.

value.population: international students, Chinese-taught programmes of the College of Computer Science and Technology

tuition.quote: Industrial Design 4 years RMB24,800/year Score 180 in HSK Level 5
tuition.notes: 2026 catalogue. The fee sits on the Industrial Design line of the College's merged row group (Industrial Design, Computer Science and Technology, Software Engineering, Information Safety); attribution to CS is read from the merged layout. Final rates are those in the admission notice (guide).

scholarship_exists.notes: Listed under the International College's 'Bachelor's Scholarships'; applied for via the home country's dispatching authority, not ZJU (pre-admission notice window 1 Dec 2025 - 28 Feb 2026). Coverage full or partial.
